parameters.content:
## SofaScore Live Scores, Standings & Team Search Data

**Actor:** [SofaScore Live Scores, Standings & Team Search Data](https://apify.com/vexaloom-labs/sofascore-live-scores-standings-and-team-search)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/sofascore-live-scores-standings-and-team-search-data.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string, required)
- `searchQueries` (array)
- `searchType` (string)
- `sports` (array)
- `date` (string)
- `daysAhead` (integer)
- `teamIds` (array)
- `playerIds` (array)
- `tournamentIds` (array)
- `eventIds` (array)
- `seasonId` (integer)
- `tableType` (string)

### Output fields
- `name` (Name)
- `eventId` (Event Id)
- `homeTeam` (Home Team)
- `awayTeam` (Away Team)
- `homeScore` (Home Score)
- `awayScore` (Away Score)
- `status` (Status)
- `startTime` (Start Time)
- `sport` (Sport)
- `tournamentName` (Tournament Name)
- `teamId` (Team Id)
- `playerId` (Player Id)

description: SofaScore live scores, standings: runs the SofaScore Live Scores, Standings & Team Search Data Apify Actor, returns name, homeTeam, awayTeam, homeScore, awayScore and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
